div.head: Episc 1
div.ab: Bisceope gebyreð ælc rihting, ge on godcundan þingan ge on woruldcundan.
Episcopo (iure) pertinet, omne rectum (omnem rectitudinem) promovere, Dei uidelicet et (ac) seculi.
It is proper for a bishop to offer guidance in all things, both in religious and secular matters.
Einem Bischofe gebührt jede Leitung sowohl in kirchlichen Dingen wie in weltlichen.
To a bishop belongs all direction, both in spiritual matters and in secular ones.
